output_list.function_name: function approveAndCall(address _spender, uint256 _value, bytes _extraData) returns (bool success)

output_list.criticism: No return value for _to contract address check. This will lead to transaction failure if _to is a contract address that does not implement the receiveApproval method, or doesnu2019t return bool. If the transaction revert, the _value of _to will be forked.

A token with a balanceOf(address) function is not the gas efficient in Ethereum. The balanceOf(address) function has a complexity of 1300, which is very high because balanceOf(address) is being called for every transfer, approve and transferFrom. Therefore, using balanceOf in functions like transferFrom, transfer, mint and burn will costs an extra 400 gas per transaction.
